description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Muhammathu Abulhasan Muhammathu Mihlar as a member of Kattankudy Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new member elected due to a resignation, which falls directly under electoral processes and related administrative matters for local authorities.
